prior_year_events.event_name: 2017 year of account - inability to close due to reinsurance uncertainty with Co/Action Specialty Group
prior_year_events.impact_description: 2017 year of account was not able to close at 72 months because of continuing uncertainty regarding reinsurance balances with Co/Action Specialty Group, creating uncertainty in reserve closure and reinsurance recoverables.

named_events.loss_description: Referenced as a key driver behind increases in gross written premium and gross claims incurred (RITC impacting reserves and balances).
Adverse development cover (ADC) cited as a major driver of increased gross premium and claims incurred.
Quoted as impacting net earned premium and having effects on claims (used to reduce retained exposure).

data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2022 were GBP 221.885m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows a net adverse prior-year movement (strengthening) of approximately GBP 9.08m (c.4.1% of opening reserves) driven by deterioration in certain underwriting years (notably 2019 and 2020 movements) and influenced by large reinsurance transactions (S5678 RITC, Hiscox ADC) and claims inflation. The report also notes a small favourable net prior year development of GBP 3.3m after reinsurance recoveries, highlighting that reinsurance flows materially affect net vs gross outcomes.
raw_causal_phrases: The 2017YOA of Syndicate 1110 has not been able to close at 72 months, by way of RITC, as a result of continuing uncertainty regarding reinsurance balances with Co/Action Specialty Group, who are the major reinsurer of the liabilities of this year of account.

The increase in net claims incurred has largely been driven by the S5678 RITC and Hiscox ADC (after the related Gibson Re WQS impact), along with the impact of claims inflation and deterioration of casualty business.
Investment return in 2022 was GBP (7.5)m (2021: GBP (1.0)m). The loss was mainly due to the increase in unrealised losses caused by higher interest rate yields in the year.

Claims incurred during the year, net of reinsurance, included positive prior year development of GBP 3.3m (2021: GBP 39.7m) on the net claims reserves that existed at the end of the prior financial year.

The most significant risk is the potential for deterioration in the claims reserves due to adverse trends in the frequency or size of claims, including the impact of inflation especially in longer tail classes.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (note: triangle presented in GBP 000). The report also explicitly states a net prior year development (net of reinsurance) of +GBP 3.3m; the divergence between gross (+GBP 9.082m) and net (+GBP 3.3m) indicates material reinsurance recoveries/allocations (funds withheld / WQS / ADC / RITC) affecting net outcomes. RITC and large reinsurance transactions (S5678 RITC, Hiscox ADC, Gibson Re WQS) may distort development comparisons. 2021 underwriting year was not presented (the Syndicate did not participate on that year), and 2022 is excluded from prior-year movement per methodology. Where LOB-level prior-year movements are not provided, amounts are left null.
